title: tenant RBAC bootstrap automation for Private installer: tenant-scoped roles, bootstrap scripts, and Helm/Terraform wiring
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: When installing Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) we need an automated, auditable, and idempotent way to bootstrap tenant-scoped RBAC and the minimal set of permissions required by the installer and tenant controllers. This PR introduces tenant-scoped role manifests, a bootstrap orchestration script used by the private-installer Helm chart and Terraform module wiring, and tests to prevent regressions.

What this changes: 
- Adds YAML templates for tenant-scoped roles and rolebindings (tenant-admin, tenant-observer, tenant-service) with least-privilege permissions for common installer and runtime operations.
- Provides a scripts/tenant_rbac_bootstrap.sh used by the Helm chart post-install hook and by Terraform null_resource for CI/CD-based installs. The script is idempotent and emits audit-friendly output for audit logs.
- Updates Helm chart values and templates (charts/private-installer/) to optionally call the bootstrap script as a post-install hook and to accept a pre-provisioned service account.
- Adds Terraform module wiring (terraform/modules/private_installer_rbac/) that can call the bootstrap script during apply, or skip when the cluster is managed by higher-level automation.
- Adds E2E integration tests in perf-canary/ that run the bootstrap flow against a kind cluster with RBAC enabled.

Checklist: 
- [x] tenant role definitions added and documented
- [x] idempotent bootstrap script implemented
- [x] Helm chart hook and values updated
- [x] Terraform module added with opt-out flag
- [x] CI integration tests added and green
- [x] Security review: minimal privileges applied

Notes and rollout plan: The bootstrap script is opt-in behind values.enableTenantRbacBootstrap (default: false). For existing Private customers, operators can migrate by enabling the Helm/Terraform hook in a maintenance window. This PR is backward compatible and does not change default runtime permissions. See linked Linear tasks for migration work and documentation follow-up.

review_comments: Diego Marquez: Please reduce the scope of tenant-admin role; granting cluster-wide 'get' on secrets is risky. Can we narrow to the operator-managed namespaces?
Asha Patel: Updated tenant-admin to only allow secret access within tenant namespaces and reworked bindings; added explicit namespacing in templates.
Linnea Sørensen: Scripts look good, but add retries and exponential backoff for API calls to avoid flakiness during large installs.
Asha Patel: Added backoff and idempotency checks; added unit tests for the retry helper.
Ravi Krishnan: Terraform module looks fine, but please add an option to pass a pre-created service account instead of creating one. Also document migration steps.
Asha Patel: Added 'precreated_service_account' and detailed migration steps in terraform README.
release_notes: Adds tenant-scoped RBAC bootstrap for Private installs (opt-in). New CLI/installer hooks and Terraform module to automate tenant role provisioning. Backwards compatible; default behaviour unchanged.
notes: Security review completed by Security team (Ravi). e2e bootstrap job added to CI; job is gated on a long-test label. Operators must opt-in to enable automatic bootstrap. Follow docs/operator/tenant-rbac-bootstrap.md for migration steps.
